artifacts.summary: 7-phase, 4-wave plan closing both contract-surface defects: a new flock-guarded orchestrate-record-decision.sh writer (plus its regression suite, manifest/inventory registration, a declared .decisions.lock ephemeral pattern, and a SKILL.md Move 4 repoint), and a verified phase-conditional severity split of the postflight no-handoff notice plus de-falsification of the same claim at its five other surfaces.

memory_candidates.content: Adding a new per-task lock file under specs/ in this agent system is a shared-lib change, not a local one: scripts/lib/runtime-file-patterns.sh declares each ephemeral path as a member replicated across SIX parallel bash arrays (name list, gitignore PATTERNS, PROBES, Check-B REGEX, IS_DIR, DIR_BASENAME) plus a pattern-count comment, and the same block is carried verbatim by context/standards/orchestrator-runtime-files.md and scripts/tests/test-orchestrate-unwind-dispatch.sh (find carriers live with grep -rln '^\*\*/\.errors\.lock$'). specs/.gitignore is GENERATED from that lib by init-specs.sh's sentinel-delimited managed block and must never be hand-edited. Critically, do NOT shortcut this by putting a lock file inside the task's already-ignored .lock/ directory: that directory is a mkdir-exclusivity mutex released by rmdir, so a stray file inside makes the release fail and leaves the task permanently locked.
